svg.title: Synth Zed — Windows icon
svg.desc: Synth fork icon family. Flat near-black plate, transparent surround. The mark is the Synth Zed carved Z: a white diagonal band with two accent-coloured S-curve carves in place of the bars. The accent (#1FD3F2 on Stable) is the only element the channel tint recolours. All visible artwork is vector geometry.
